sb.name: Expert
sb.languages: Common, plus one of your choice

traits.name: Helpful
traits.desc: The expert can take the Help action as a bonus action.

traits.name: Tools
traits.desc: The expert has thieves' tools and a musical instrument.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

sb.name: Spellcaster
sb.languages: Common, plus one of your choice

traits.name: Magical Role
traits.desc: Choose a role for the spellcaster: healer or mage. Your choice determines which Spellcasting trait to use below.

traits.name: Spellcasting (Healer)
traits.desc:
The spellcaster's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The spellcaster has following cleric spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Sacred Flame|sacred flame]]
- **1st level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|cure wounds]]

traits.name: Spellcasting (Mage)
traits.desc:
The spellcaster's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). The spellcaster has following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Fire Bolt|fire bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]]
- **1st level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Sleep|sleep]]

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands.

sb.name: Warrior
sb.languages: Common, plus one of your choice

traits.name: Martial Role
traits.desc:
The warrior has one of the following traits of your choice:

- **Attacker.** The warrior gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls.
- **Defender.** The warrior gains the Protection reaction below.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage, or 7 (1d10 + 2) slashing damage if used with two hands.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Protection (Defender Only)
reactions.desc: The warrior imposes disadvantage on the attack roll of a creature within 5 feet of it whose target isn't the warrior. The warrior must be able to see the attacker.
